unit: H135 - expiry and disposal: destroy with a witness (write-off) or return to the supplier (debit note)

return or use it before it expires.en: return or use it before it expires
return or use it before it expires.fr: à retourner ou utiliser avant péremption

What expires or is recalled is destroyed.ar: ما ينتهي أو يُسحب يُتلف بحضور شاهد أو يُرد إلى مورّده
What expires or is recalled is destroyed.en: What expires or is recalled is destroyed with a witness or returned to its supplier
What expires or is recalled is destroyed.fr: Ce qui est périmé ou rappelé est détruit devant témoin ou retourné au fournisseur

Nothing on the shelves has expired, is n.ar: لا شيء على الرفوف منتهٍ أو قريب الانتهاء أو في الحجر.
Nothing on the shelves has expired, is n.en: Nothing on the shelves has expired, is near expiry or is in quarantine.
Nothing on the shelves has expired, is n.fr: Rien en rayon n'est périmé, proche de la péremption ou en quarantaine.

Nothing was destroyed or returned yet..ar: لم يُتلف أو يُرد شيء بعد.
Nothing was destroyed or returned yet..en: Nothing was destroyed or returned yet.
Nothing was destroyed or returned yet..fr: Rien n'a encore été détruit ni retourné.

The inventory writes the batch off at co.ar: المخزن يشطب التشغيلة بالتكلفة (مصروف شطب مقابل المخزون)، وشاهد يؤكد بكلمة سره.
The inventory writes the batch off at co.en: The inventory writes the batch off at cost (write-off expense against inventory). A witness confirms with their own password.
The inventory writes the batch off at co.fr: Le stock sort le lot au coût (charge de mise au rebut contre stock). Un témoin confirme avec son mot de passe.

A debit note against the supplier at cos.ar: إشعار مدين على المورّد بالتكلفة من حسابات الموردين. التشغيلة المنتهية تُتلف ولا تُرد.
A debit note against the supplier at cos.en: A debit note against the supplier at cost, written by the payables. An expired batch is destroyed instead.
A debit note against the supplier at cos.fr: Un avoir fournisseur au coût, émis par les comptes fournisseurs. Un lot périmé est détruit.

Return and write the debit note.en: Return and write the debit note

Destroy this batch and write it off?.en: Destroy this batch and write it off?
Destroy this batch and write it off?.fr: Détruire ce lot et le sortir du stock ?

Return this batch to the supplier and wr.ar: رد هذه التشغيلة للمورّد وكتابة الإشعار المدين؟
Return this batch to the supplier and wr.en: Return this batch to the supplier and write the debit note?
Return this batch to the supplier and wr.fr: Retourner ce lot et émettre l'avoir ?

The witness enters their password.fr: Le témoin saisit son mot de passe

The store does not hold that much of thi.ar: المخزن لا يحتوي هذه الكمية من التشغيلة
The store does not hold that much of thi.en: The store does not hold that much of this batch
The store does not hold that much of thi.fr: Le magasin ne détient pas autant de ce lot

An expired batch is destroyed, not retur.ar: التشغيلة المنتهية تُتلف ولا تُرد للمورّد
An expired batch is destroyed, not retur.en: An expired batch is destroyed, not returned to the supplier
An expired batch is destroyed, not retur.fr: Un lot périmé est détruit, pas retourné

Another batch of this medicine would lea.ar: تشغيلة أخرى من نفس الدواء ستخرج أولًا من هذا المخزن — احجز هذه التشغيلة وردّها من الحجر
Another batch of this medicine would lea.en: Another batch of this medicine would leave the store first — quarantine this batch and return it from there
Another batch of this medicine would lea.fr: Un autre lot sortirait en premier — mettez ce lot en quarantaine et retournez-le de là
